single optional action (like *undo*). In practice the two words are used
interchangeably; "toast" is the older and more widespread term, from the way the

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.definition: A panel docked to one edge of the screen that slides in over the content, holding navigation or the details of the thing you selected.

toast.name: Toast
toast.definition: A brief, self-dismissing message that appears at a screen edge to confirm an action or report status without interrupting the user's flow.

marching-ants.name: Marching ants
marching-ants.definition: The animated dashed outline that circles a selection, moving continuously so the boundary reads as active rather than drawn.

count-up-animation.name: Count-up animation
count-up-animation.definition: Animating a number toward its value instead of setting it, often with digits rolling like an odometer so the change is legible.

kanban-board.name: Kanban board
kanban-board.definition: A row of vertical columns, each one a stage, holding cards that move sideways as work progresses.

gauge.name: Gauge
gauge.definition: A dial style readout showing one value on an arc between a minimum and a maximum, borrowed from instrument panels.

signature-pad.name: Signature pad
signature-pad.definition: A drawing area that captures a handwritten signature by pointer or touch, with a clear control and a baseline to sign on.

squash-and-stretch.name: Squash and stretch
squash-and-stretch.definition: Deforming an element along its direction of travel so it reads as having mass and flexibility, usually as a press squash or a launch stretch.

breadcrumbs.name: Breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.definition: A trail of links showing the path from the top of a hierarchy down to the current page, with every level above it clickable on the way back up.

minimap.name: Minimap
minimap.definition: A shrunken overview of a long document or canvas beside the scrollbar, with a box showing which part is currently on screen.

bottom-sheet.name: Bottom sheet
bottom-sheet.definition: A surface anchored to the bottom edge that slides up over the content, often draggable between a peeked and an expanded height.

juiciness.name: Juiciness
juiciness.definition: Stacking far more feedback on an act than it needs, so one small input wobbles, pops and sings, and the interface feels alive under the hand.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.definition: The numbered row of page links under a long result set, with previous and next controls and usually an ellipsis where numbers are skipped.

complementary-colors.name: Complementary colors
complementary-colors.definition: Two hues sitting opposite each other on the colour wheel, the pairing that produces the strongest contrast and the loudest accent.

neon-glow.name: Neon glow
neon-glow.definition: A saturated colour surrounded by layered soft shadows of the same hue, so type or a border reads as a lit tube against a dark surface.

neubrutalism.name: Neubrutalism
neubrutalism.definition: A loud style built from thick black outlines, saturated flat color, square corners, and hard offset shadows with zero blur.

sliding-indicator.name: Sliding indicator
sliding-indicator.definition: A single underline or pill that travels between tabs to mark the selection instead of each tab drawing its own, so the move itself says which way the selection went.
